question: What lasting spiritual effect is attributed to consuming the divine sacred offering?
premises: A divine sacred offering is eaten.
Its effect extends to seven births.
The offering is associated with the animal.
inference: Eating the divine sacred offering produces an effect lasting through seven births.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of paśum in relation to caruṃ is ambiguous
plain_english: Indeed, the divine sacred offering, when eaten, has an effect lasting for seven births, in relation to the animal.
